svg.text: Process Monitoring: Normal Execution vs SPEMCS Interception

g.text: BEFORE: Unmonitored Process Execution
Candidate Launches Cheating Tools Freely
• OS kernel spawns process in Session 1+ with normal user privileges
• No security agent or ETW event sink listens to process lifecycle
1. Candidate executes AnyDesk.exe or Discord.exe
Binary loaded from user Downloads / AppData folder without administrative prompt.
Status: Process ID allocated, threads created, network sockets opened.
2. Remote Connection Established
AnyDesk connects to external relay server; external party views exam screen.
Proctor has zero visibility into background processes running on lab PC.
3. Undetected Exam Compromise
External solver controls mouse/keyboard or answers questions in real time.
Audit trail: NONE. Logged events: NONE. Exam marked as valid submission.
Critical Failure Modes of Traditional Proctoring:
❌ Periodic polling (e.g. every 10-30s) misses ephemeral scripts and fast exits
❌ Rename attacks (renaming anydesk.exe to svchost.exe) bypass naive name filters
❌ User-space proctors can be killed via Task Manager or Process Hacker
❌ Virtual machines (VMware / VirtualBox) hide the real host operating environment
❌ Secondary screen sharing software streams video without physical cable detection
AFTER: SPEMCS Real-Time Process Interception (<50ms)
WMI / ETW Kernel Event Hooks in Session 0
• Event Tracing for Windows & WMI __InstanceCreationEvent registered at service start
• Captures process creation across all Windows desktop sessions synchronously
1. Candidate executes AnyDesk.exe
Kernel generates Win32_Process creation event in <10ms.
Event captured by ConfigurableProcessClassifier in Session 0.
2. Deep Signature & Path Classification
Classifier evaluates: process_name, executable_path, command_line arguments.
Matches prohibited category: "RemoteDesktop" | Severity: CRITICAL
3. Telemetry Stream & Dashboard Alert
Agent sends POST /api/v1/events with Device HMAC Token.
Backend writes to events & alerts tables; broadcasts via WSS to proctors.
Enforcement Guarantees Verified in Source Code:
✅ Sub-50ms detection latency via WMI __InstanceCreationEvent subscription
✅ Session 0 privilege ring prevents student process from killing the monitor
✅ Network lockdown prevents the spawned tool from phoning home even before killed
✅ Prohibited process events outside exam recorded due to nullable alerts.exam_id
✅ Verified in code: ProcessClassifier.cs | EtwDnsListener.cs | EventUploaderWorker.cs
